text:
maya.chang: quick Q — I'm updating the payments helm chart to pull DB creds from k8s secrets. Should we: use a values.yaml field that points to a secret name and then use valueFrom/secretKeyRef in the Deployment, or wire it via ExternalSecrets/ExternalSecret CRD? We're also provisioning the secret via Terraform -> sealed-secrets in CI.

jonathan: i'd go ExternalSecrets if you can — keeps the secret lifecycle out of helm. helm should only reference the secret name. avoids templating secrets into releases. also easier to rotate without helm rollouts.

alex_k: fwiw if you do keep it in helm, don't render secret values in templates. only reference name/key. example snippet: 
```yaml
# values.yaml
secrets:
  dbSecretName: "payments-db-{{ .Release.Namespace }}"

# deployment.yaml (template)
env:
  - name: DB_PASSWORD
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: {{ .Values.secrets.dbSecretName | quote }}
        key: password
```
If you need release interpolation for values from values.yaml, use `tpl` around the string: `{{ tpl .Values.secrets.dbSecretName . }}` — common gotcha.

maya.chang: got it. Our current TF flow produces a sealedsecret called `payments-db-secret` in each namespace. If we switch to ExternalSecrets, do we need extra RBAC?

jonathan: yes — ExternalSecrets operator needs permissions to read from the secret provider (or the provider controller). Also the ExternalSecret CRD will create a k8s Secret, so the operator's SA needs create/update secrets in the target namespace. Add a ClusterRoleBinding or namespace-scoped Role depending on how you run it.

sre_matt: quick checklist before maya makes the change: 1) ensure TF CI writes sealedsecret into target namespace (we already do this for staging). 2) if moving to ExternalSecrets, update TF to provision the provider creds in a secure store (don't bake into helm). 3) add unit in chart docs on secretName vs ExternalSecret. 4) ping me or @jonathan for TF plan review.

maya.chang: thanks — i'll do ExternalSecrets for prod and keep helm-only secret name refs in staging to reduce churn. I'll open a PR with values.yaml docs + the tpl example and link the TF plan.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: CI: helm lint passes for payments chart :white_check_mark:

jonathan: tiny note — use `secretKeyRef` not `secretRef` in env valueFrom (many people mix those up).

maya.chang: good call, fixed in my branch. tagging @sre_matt for final TF review. :pray:
